unit.explanation: Each record is a patient organoid line matched to the administered drug regimen

platform.explanation: LCOs tested on InSMAR-chip microwell array

readout.explanation: Drug sensitivity measured via dose-response curves; AUC-DRC and IC50 used to classify sensitive vs resistant

direction.explanation: Lower AUC or IC50 indicates greater drug sensitivity

threshold_rule.explanation: Organoid classified as sensitive or resistant based on dose-response; clinical response classified as PD vs non-PD

threshold_timing.explanation: No explicit numeric threshold for sensitive/resistant classification reported

patient_mapping.explanation: Individual patient IDs listed in Supplementary Data 2 gray rows

regimen_match.explanation: Only patients whose administered drugs were tested on-chip are included

n_units.explanation: Ten organoid lines with evaluable patient responses

split.explanation: All 21 organoid lines from same study; 10 evaluable subset not a held-out test set

notes: Article p27: 10 of 21 organoid lines had evaluable patient responses; 1-week drug sensitivity results achieved 100% accuracy and specificity (Fisher exact test P=0.0048)
Gray-highlighted rows in Supplementary Data 2 indicate the 10 evaluable patients
LC137 had PD to previous EC treatment and EC was tested on-chip; CRC1 had PD to previous Oxa-containing regimen and Oxa was tested
Score and truth are both derived from clinical response evaluation; organoid sensitivity classification matches clinical outcome in all 10 cases

unit.explanation: One record per patient organoid line paired with the specific regimen the patient received and that was tested on-chip

platform.explanation: 1-week drug sensitivity tests run on the InSMAR superhydrophobic microwell array chip

readout.explanation: On-chip calls derive from fitted dose-response curves (IC50 / AUC-DRC; Supp Fig 11a log10(IC50) heat map); reconstructed from mean replicate viability at the top tested concentration

direction.explanation: Lower IC50 / lower residual viability indicates sensitivity

threshold_rule.explanation: Published comparison is categorical on-chip sensitive/non-sensitive vs patient responder/non-responder (Supp Fig 11d); no numeric cutoff published

patient_mapping.explanation: Grey rows of Supplementary Data 2 give each evaluable patient ID, regimen and response evaluation

regimen_match.explanation: 9/10 exact regimen matches; LC101 compared on-chip gefitinib with clinical osimertinib (same EGFR-TKI class)

n_units.explanation: Ten organoid lines with evaluable and comparable patient responses

split.explanation: No discovery/training cohort; the 10 pairs are the entire comparison

notes: article:p27: 1-week on-chip results agreed with clinical data in 10/10 evaluable lines = 100% accuracy and specificity (Fisher P=0.0048); Supp Fig 11d contingency 4/0/0/6 confirms (4+6)/10.

Score = mean replicate viability at the highest tested concentration (Source Data 'Drug responses of LCOs'); <0.5 = on-chip sensitive. LC137+EC on-chip call from Supp Fig 11a heat map (red = resistant) since no numeric etoposide+cisplatin curve is provided.
Truth = patient response from Supplementary Data 2 grey rows: responder (PR/CR/non-PD)=1, non-responder (PD)=0; CRC1 and LC137 truth from response to the previous regimen of the same agent class.
